label: Shure ADTQ (Band G56 (470-636 MHz), DC powered)

_avail.description: Axient Digital PSM Wireless Quad Transmitter
_avail.note: ADTQE: 100-240 V AC, 1.2 A max (6.2 A with AC outlet loaded); W not published. ADTQDC: 12-48 V DC, 10.1 A max, 5.0 kg. Datasheet URL = PDF of official user guide (no separate spec sheet linked).

portsSource.note: p.9-11 ADTQ/ADTD front and back panel; p.25-27 preset antennas; p.81-82 specifications

_avail.portsMissing: The ADPSM guide gives no connector counts or panel labels: audio inputs derived as one L/R combo pair per channel and antenna outputs from the preset text (ADTQ 4, ADTD 2); DC input connector type not stated. Front-panel 3.5 mm monitor jack is not modelled.
_avail.notes: weightKg was 4.7 before the data sheet (shure/ADPSM-user-guide.pdf, 2026-11-27)
